mapper.select: UPDATE chat_group SET next_message_sequence = next_message_sequence + 1 WHERE id = #{groupId} RETURNING next_message_sequence - 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id, group_id, sender_user_id, type, content, created_at, sequence_number) VALUES (#{message.id}, #{message.groupId}, #{message.senderUserId}, #{message.type}, #{message.content}, #{message.createdAt}, #{message.sequenceNumber})

INSERT INTO chat_attachment (id, message_id, content_type, width, height, byte_size, data) VALUES (#{attachment.id}, #{attachment.messageId}, #{attachment.contentType}, #{attachment.width}, #{attachment.height}, #{attachment.byteSize}, #{attachment.data})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_message WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND id = #{messageId})

SELECT page.id, page.sender_user_id, page.sender_nickname, page.type, page.content, page.created_at, page.attachment_id, page.attachment_content_type, page.attachment_width, page.attachment_height, page.attachment_byte_size, page.attachment_file_name FROM ( SELECT m.id, m.sequence_number, m.sender_user_id, users.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.type, m.content, m.created_at, COALESCE(attachment.id, file_attachment.id) AS attachment_id, COALESCE(attachment.content_type, 'application/octet-stream') AS attachment_content_type, attachment.width AS attachment_width, attachment.height AS attachment_height, COALESCE(attachment.byte_size, file_attachment.byte_size) AS attachment_byte_size, file_attachment.file_name AS attachment_file_name FROM chat_message m JOIN app_user users ON users.id = m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN chat_attachment attachment ON attachment.message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN chat_file_attachment file_attachment ON file_attachment.message_id = m.id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId}
AND m.sequence_number < (SELECT cursor.sequence_number FROM chat_message cursor WHERE cursor.group_id = #{groupId} AND cursor.id = #{beforeMessageId})
AND m.sequence_number > (SELECT cursor.sequence_number FROM chat_message cursor WHERE cursor.group_id = #{groupId} AND cursor.id = #{afterMessageId})
ORDER BY m.sequence_number ORDER BY m.sequence_number DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) page ORDER BY page.sequence_number

SELECT attachment.id, attachment.file_name, attachment.byte_size FROM chat_file_attachment attachment JOIN chat_message message ON message.id = attachment.message_id WHERE message.group_id = #{groupId} AND attachment.id = #{attachmentId}

SELECT message.id, message.sender_user_id, users.nickname AS sender_nickname, message.type, message.content, message.created_at, attachment.id AS attachment_id, 'application/octet-stream' AS attachment_content_type, NULL AS attachment_width, NULL AS attachment_height, attachment.byte_size AS attachment_byte_size, attachment.file_name AS attachment_file_name FROM chat_file_attachment attachment JOIN chat_message message ON message.id = attachment.message_id JOIN app_user users ON users.id = message.sender_user_id WHERE message.group_id = #{groupId} AND attachment.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND message.sender_user_id = #{senderUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_file_attachment (id, message_id, upload_id, file_name, byte_size) VALUES (#{attachment.id}, #{attachment.messageId}, #{attachment.uploadId}, #{attachment.fileName}, #{attachment.byteSize})
mapper.update: WITH reservation AS ( DELETE FROM chat_file_upload_reservation WHERE id = #{uploadId} AND byte_size = #{byteSize} RETURNING byte_size ) UPDATE chat_file_storage_quota SET reserved_bytes = reserved_bytes - reservation.byte_size, used_bytes = used_bytes + reservation.byte_size FROM reservation WHERE id = 1 AND reserved_bytes >= reservation.byte_size

WITH reservation AS ( DELETE FROM chat_file_upload_reservation WHERE id = #{uploadId} RETURNING byte_size ) UPDATE chat_file_storage_quota SET reserved_bytes = reserved_bytes - reservation.byte_size FROM reservation WHERE id = 1 AND reserved_bytes >= reservation.byte_size
mapper.select: SELECT id, byte_size, created_at FROM chat_file_upload_reservation WHERE created_at < #{createdBefore}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_file_attachment WHERE id = #{attachmentId})
